These findings could inform development of new treatment strategies to address antimicrobial resistance, described as a silent pandemic.

summary: Research finds that four pathogens account for most infection-related cancers, with prevention through established and emerging vaccines critical.

title: Anthropic's Claude enzyme discovery raises questions about AI use of existing research
summary: A biologist questioned whether Anthropic's Claude AI system may have incorporated existing unpublished work when discovering an unusual enzyme family.

title: Study finds strength training shrinks fat cells in mice within seven days
summary: Seven days of strength training sessions in obese mice triggered shrinkage of visceral fat cells and reactivated fat-burning molecular pathways without overall weight loss.

title: Jonathan the Giant Tortoise at 194 Years Reveals Aging and Longevity Secrets
summary: Scientists analyzing the DNA of Jonathan, a 194-year-old giant tortoise, have uncovered insights into the biological mechanisms of aging and extreme longevity.

title: New approach treats gum disease by disrupting bacterial communication
summary: Scientists discovered that disrupting bacterial quorum sensing can shift dental plaque toward a healthier microbial balance without killing beneficial species.

title: Blocking P2X7 receptor reduces brain inflammation linked to neurological diseases
summary: Researchers found that inhibiting the P2X7 receptor significantly reduced inflammation in human brain tissue, offering a potential therapeutic strategy for Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and other neurological conditions.

title: Leucine boosts cellular energy by protecting mitochondrial proteins
summary: Leucine protects key mitochondrial proteins from destruction, boosting cellular energy production and revealing a new link between nutrition and metabolism.

title: ESA's Juice spacecraft uses Earth gravity assist to reach Jupiter trajectory
summary: ESA's Juice spacecraft conducted an Earth flyby on September 28, using gravitational assistance to reshape its path toward Jupiter and increase its speed by 3.5 km/s.

title: Enzyme UBE2N shows promise in slowing fatty liver disease progression
summary: Scientists have identified an enzyme called UBE2N that may help prevent fatty liver disease from worsening by clearing damaged mitochondria and breaking down fat.
